data_fields.name: item_footprint_cells
data_fields.donor_constant: art size divided by slot size (sizes not tabled here)

best_idea: A move onto a grid is decided over the whole footprint first (empty = drop, one item = swap, two = refuse) and written only after that check, so a refused move leaves the hand and the grid untouched.
decision_why: The footprint check, the one-for-one swap and the all-or-nothing repack fit one ledger; the donor's rollback count defect must be fixed and its per-size scan orders and cell encoding are not copied; the licence does not clearly cover use in a commercial game, so clean-room only.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a move onto two different items returns the held item to the hand unchanged and writes no cell, that a move onto exactly one item swaps the two with no stale cells, and that a failing repack leaves the grid and item list identical to their prior state; on a 375 px phone the drag target outline turns red when the move would be refused.
